theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  intro d e f h i
  obtain ⟨hde, hef⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨_, hd⟩ := (hrelation d e).mp hde
  obtain ⟨_, he⟩ := (hrelation e f).mp hef
  have hn : ∀ u : Fin 9 → ℤ, digits_to_num u = ∑ j : Fin 9, u j * (10 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ) :=
    fun u => congrFun hdigits_to_num u
  have rep : ∀ u v : Fin 9 → ℤ, ∀ k : Fin 9,
      digits_to_num (fun j => if j = k then v j else u j)
        = digits_to_num u + (v k - u k) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (k : ℕ) := by
    intro u v k
    rw [hn, hn, ← Fintype.sum_ite_eq' k (fun j => (v j - u j) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ)),
      ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
    by_cases h : j = k
    · simp [h]; ring
    · simp [h]
  have hsum : ∑ k : Fin 9, (e k - d k) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (k : ℕ) = digits_to_num e - digits_to_num d := by
    rw [hn, hn]
    simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, sub_mul]
  have A : ∀ k : Fin 9, 7 ∣ digits_to_num d + (e k - d k) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (k : ℕ) := by
    intro k
    rw [← rep d e k]
    exact hd k
  have B : 7 ∣ digits_to_num e + (f i - e i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) := by
    rw [← rep e f i]
    exact he i
  have S : 7 ∣ digits_to_num d + digits_to_num e := by
    have h₁ : 7 ∣ ∑ k : Fin 9, (digits_to_num d + (e k - d k) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (k : ℕ)) :=
      Finset.dvd_sum fun k _ => A k
    have h₂ : ∑ k : Fin 9, (digits_to_num d + (e k - d k) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (k : ℕ))
        = 9 * digits_to_num d + (digits_to_num e - digits_to_num d) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← hsum]
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
    rw [h₂] at h₁
    rw [show digits_to_num d + digits_to_num e
        = 9 * digits_to_num d + (digits_to_num e - digits_to_num d) - 7 * digits_to_num d from by ring]
    exact h₁.sub (dvd_mul_right 7 _)
  have h₃ : 7 ∣ (d i - f i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) := by
    rw [show (d i - f i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ)
        = digits_to_num d + digits_to_num e
          - (digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ)
            + (digits_to_num e + (f i - e i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ))) from by ring]
    exact S.sub ((A i).add B)
  have c7 : IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) 10 := ⟨3, -2, by decide⟩
  exact c7.pow_right.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right h₃
